pin.title: Lwandlana village, outside Mthatha (map point approximate): police sergeant shot dead during an operation, 17 Nov
pin.location_note: APPROXIMATE MAP POINT. Lwandlana village (the Daily Dispatch says in the Tabase administrative area) outside Mthatha. Neither is in Nominatim near Mthatha (its only "Tabase" is a village in Elundini), so the pin is the Mthatha city point (-31.5896, 28.7878). Area level, about 10 km.
